info.name: Vibishan API
info.description:
All Vibishan endpoints (see backend-api-spec.md).

Run '0. Setup' first: it resets the DB to seed data and stores a token per seed user. Then run any folder, or the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Seed password for every user: password123.

item.name: 0. Setup

request.description: Requires ENABLE_DEV_ENDPOINTS=true. Run this before the flows for a clean state.

item.description: Run first: resets the DB and stores a JWT for every seed user in collection variables.
